history.name: The size chip reads without the legend
history.description: Each feature's size prints as a chip carrying a three-step meter, filled to the level that size sits at. Someone who never read the key on the front page still sees at a glance that one entry outranks another.
history.dev_notes: LedgerHtml#sizeChip(); the same chip is what the front-page key shows, rather than a description of it.
